div.head: VI Atr 30
div.ab: K. Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forþ georne wordes ⁊ weorces; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
⁊ lufige man Godes riht heonan forð georne wordes ⁊ dæda; þonne wurð us Godes miltse þe gearuwre.
Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forþ georne wordes ⁊ weorces; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
Ac lufige man Godes riht heonan forþ georne wordes and weorces; þonne wyrð þysse þeode sona God milde.
Sondern man achte hinfort Gottes Gebot sorgsam in Wort und Werk (Thaten D); dann wird Gott alsbald diesem Volke gnädig werden (uns Gottes Gnade umso bereitwilliger D).
But let God's law be eagerly loved henceforth in word and work (deeds, D); then God will soon become merciful to this people (God's mercy will be all the readier for us, D).
But God's law shall henceforth be zealously cherished in word and in deed; then God will forthwith be gracious towards this people.
But God’s law is to be willingly embraced henceforth in word and deed; then will God immediately show mercy to this people.
